name: Solar Mini 4.5 Preview
archDisplay: Mixture-of-Experts (35B total / 3B active); reasoning mode available
note: Early-access preview of Upstage's Solar Mini 4.5, released Nov 23, 2026 per the Console version list (solar-mini-4-5-preview, also in the Nov 23 changelog). Closed weights, API only (Upstage Console, OpenRouter, on-prem). 35B total / 3B active MoE like Solar Mini 4, 512K context, 128K max output, August 2026 training cutoff, reasoning mode, tool calling and structured outputs; English, Korean and Japanese. Price is the $0.10 input / $0.40 output / $0.01 cached per Mtok list price; the 90% preview discount ($0.01 / $0.04) is promotional and not filed. Upstage says Solar Mini 4.5 is officially released on Dec 3, 2026, when this ID routes to solar-mini-4-5. No benchmark figures are published (Upstage's Korean newsletter says only that it beat Solar Pro 4 in internal tests), so it is spec-only and unranked.
